beats.text: Two servers update the same record at once.
beats.say: Two servers try to update the same record at the same moment. Both read the value, ten.

beats.text: Last write wins: one update is lost.
beats.say: Server A adds five, server B adds two. Whoever writes last wins, so one update is silently lost.

beats.text: A lock: one worker at a time.
beats.say: A distributed lock makes sure only one worker can enter the critical section at a time.

beats.text: A gets the lock. B has to wait.
beats.say: A asks the lock service for the lock, and gets it. B asks, and has to wait.

beats.text: A releases. B goes. The result is correct.
beats.say: When A finishes, it releases the lock. Now B goes, and the final result is correct.

beats.text: Locks expire. A slow worker can lose its lock.
beats.say: Locks need an expiry, so a crashed worker can't hold one forever. But a slow worker can lose its lock while still working.
The fix is a fencing token. Every lock grant gets a bigger number, and the database rejects writes with an old token.
